draft_notes.author: host
draft_notes.explanation: Detect the complete coloured row and column on the borders, then fill an interior cell exactly when its corresponding border colours match. Distinct legend colours make the equal-colour intersections the intended diagonal rectangles. Every D4 and palette uses the same direct visible-coordinate operation.

draft_notes.limitations: Requires complete edge legends, distinct nonbackground band colours and the original single background role; these are constructor invariants.
